name: Gmail MCP
description: Google's official remote MCP server for Gmail, in Developer Preview: searches and reads threads, creates and lists drafts, and adds or removes labels with the user's own permissions.

skills.name: Thread Search
skills.description: Searches Gmail threads and retrieves a full thread with its messages.

skills.name: Draft Creation
skills.description: Creates draft emails and lists the drafts already in the mailbox.

skills.name: Label Organization
skills.description: Lists Gmail labels and adds or removes them on messages and threads.
